notes.title: Achievement Testing starting soon (update)
notes.content:
I will shortly start to test achievements and will hopefully be able to release achievements to the public quickly.


Edit: Sadly it seems I'm not able to add Steam achievements at this time, I've been trying and looking online for guides but have yet to figure out how to get achievements to work. I will continue to try and get achievements added to this game but I do not know when I will finally succeed.
